_legend: Phase 7 map format (structured cells). Each stage's `cells` is a list of rows; a row is either a plain glyph string (compact, no per-cell overrides) or a list of cells, where a cell is a bare glyph string or an object {"g": glyph, "m": material}. `m` overrides a cell's cosmetic material regardless of glyph or theme (a wild on water, dirt kept brown in a building area). Legacy `grid` (bare-glyph strings) is still read as a fallback. Every stage is stitched into a single shared world at its `world_pos` (map editor World View), so a stage's cells are frequently reachable only through its neighbour. Terrain glyphs are cosmetic and theme-relative (see docs/TERRAIN_PALETTE.md); walkability is decided here. Barriers: # wall, T tree, H hedge, ^ mountain, B/b building, O boulder, + railing, I pillar, ~ deep water (non-surfable), * lava. Walkable terrain: . ground, ; tall grass, , dirt, = road, : sand, s surf water (walkable, gated by a surf ability), _ interior/gym floor. Objects (walkable): S run spawn (first segment only; exactly one in the whole world), X exit gate (opened by this stage's leader; a stage with no leader is never gated), c center, m mart, w wild encounter (only spawns if the segment has a non-empty `wild_pool`), t route trainer (only spawns if the segment has a `trainers` spec), L leader gate, D gym door. A leader's trigger cell is the tile south of `L` and the arc faces north; the gate blocks only the `L` tile itself until its slot is cleared, so progression must be gated by map chokepoints.
